scope: local source development and acceptance; no deployment or delivery synchronization

implementation.targets: only model ancestors of primary published outputs; unused camera restoration preview excluded
implementation.defaults: optional LoRA disabled; no catalog dependency when disabled
implementation.history: published API JSON and old tasks unchanged; original test LoRA bypass applies only to new optional requests
implementation.requiredLoras: camera acceleration and control adapters retained
implementation.identity: full SHA-256 for selected LoRA and actual base weights; metadata variant + every target matrix/layer checked; Worker and node revalidate
implementation.candidateModelTests: catalog uses candidate snapshot and locked replacement fields; administrator only; changed/published candidates rejected
implementation.fixedDependencies: New requests cannot override versioned model filenames through old scalar fields, including when optionalLora is omitted. Normal forms hide these fields; administrator version inspection and controlled model updates remain available. Old task records/results are unchanged; old pending tasks retain their execution path.

nativeAdapters.scope: real ComfyUI patch mapping on tiny CPU model/encoder, wrapped text encoder mapping, context immutability, real diffusers/PEFT forward with existing adapter retained

integration.comfyService: protocol fixture; distinct from GPU checks

globalLint.preserved: unrelated existing contract materials kept unchanged
globalLint.additionalBaselineEslint: direct broad scan also finds two existing catalog-specifier errors in unchanged apps/platform-api/package.json (@xmldom/xmldom and fflate); changed-code ESLint passes

productionDependencyImage.scope: current ComfyUI source mounted read-only into the existing production dependency image; isolated --rm container with --network none; tiny CPU models, not full inference or a rebuilt image

gpu.scope: real local CUDA; Flux2 Klein 9B text-to-image off/on and numbered region editing with optional context LoRA

limitations: No full-size GPU LoRA effect acceptance for Qwen image editing, Qwen text generators, Hunyuan3D or HYPIR; no suitable declared test adapters supplied for these architectures. Their graph/contracts and native loader units are covered separately.
Unknown model variants, absent declarations and unsupported LoRA formats are excluded; compatible loading does not establish design quality.
No Git commit/push, local delivery regeneration, server sync or server deployment in this task.
sourceComfyMode: ComfyUI extension source tracked by this SHA-256 snapshot for subsequent controlled delivery; no remote ComfyUI push required by project workflow.
